title: Carlson's Masonic initiation and becoming master of his lodge

tellings.quote: I was raised in March of 1979, became master of my lodge in 1990.

plain: A researcher of ancient history, Randall Carlson, says he was raised as a Freemason, meaning he joined the old fraternal order known for its rituals and symbols, in March 1979. He says that by 1990 he had become master, the head, of his local lodge, which he offers as background to his interest in old esoteric knowledge.
